thesis: SPY closed at 715.87 with a 10-session return of -2.34%, a 50-session SMA of 761.48 and 23.45% annualized volatility. The WEAK tier sets a target of -10% of equity in S&P 500 exposure; SH at 1x daily leverage expresses it with about 10% of equity in cash.
invalidation: The tier is re-evaluated on every completed session: exit or reduce when the tier drops or the direction flips. Overnight gaps can move the position beyond the 2% daily drawdown brake.
